body:
Lessons from source-only reads and returns, from Termal::Opus3's w-3fe8 work on 2026-11-02:
(1) When claiming that "X never happens" (for example, "construction starts no worker"), grep for the CALL of every entry point as well as its internals. cfg(test) AppState::new_with_paths (app_boot.rs ~432–444) runs run_post_listen_boot() before returning, which resumes retained observation workers (resume_runtime_observation_reports). So a test hook installed after a restart constructor can race. Use the pre-listen seam: new_before_listen_with_paths under the boot TLS (TEST_ENGRAM_BOOT_TRANSPORT and TEST_ENGRAM_BOOT_BUDGET_CLOCK) and boot_on_test_temp_root, then install the hook, then run_post_listen_boot.
(2) Line endings on Windows Git Bash: `grep -c $'\r$'` and `od -c | grep '\r'` give false CRLF readings. Count CR bytes exactly with `git cat-file -p REV:PATH | od -An -v -tx1 | tr -s ' ' '\n' | grep -cx 0d`. Source blobs in the w-3fe8 assembly trees (50226370, 91db2eb2, b1cf65e9) are LF.
(3) Never delete an .evidence patch file that has already been advertised to an assembler, even when superseded; keep every advertised patch until the item closes.
